development.title: Cross Creek Studio
development.summary: Cross Creek Studio is a live e-commerce platform I designed and built independently, including the customer storefront and the administrative tools behind it.

capabilities.title: Commerce
capabilities.description: Products, variants, inventory, carts, promo codes, configurable tax and shipping, and PayPal checkout.

capabilities.title: Operations
capabilities.description: Order management, status updates, customer confirmations, tracking messages, and role-based administration.

capabilities.title: Content
capabilities.description: A seasonal gallery, product imagery, contact flows, and tools for managing a changing catalog.

capabilities.title: Production
capabilities.description: Responsive layouts, server-side validation, transactional data, search metadata, and a maintained live deployment.

story.heading: The brief
story.body: Cross Creek Studio needed more than a brochure. It needed a storefront that could explain unusual products, support a large visual catalog, take real orders, and remain manageable for the people running the business.

story.heading: The difficult work
story.body: The hardest problems lived between screens: keeping variant inventory and cart quantities consistent, calculating discounts, tax, and shipping on the server, handing a confirmed payment into an order, and giving an administrator enough control without exposing private operations to shoppers. Those details took repeated testing and refinement.
